notes.subject: יתענג
notes.rationale: literal 'be soft/pliable', rendered as ikgantša (delight oneself), the idiom 'set delight upon'

notes.subject: A
notes.rationale: interrogative carried by אם as 'whether', Sepedi needs A

notes.subject: יקרא/קרא
notes.rationale: 'call upon' echoes Job's earlier cries; the hypocrite does not call — the question turns the verb of prayer back on him

translation: A o tla ikgantša ⟨go⟩ Shadai, go bitša Eloha ka nako e nngwe le e nngwe?
